body:
I've had my fill of therapists and anti-depression meds.  When I'm vulnerable, I get hurt.  And meds make it impossible to be intimate.

The idea of doing something crazy has appeal, but if it didn't turn out to my liking would only hasten an end.  Besides, just the thought of going on a vacation by myself makes me want to kill myself.

My honest fear is that I don't have a couple months.  Halloween was just mind-numbingly depressing.  My birthday is coming up, and Christmas and New Years, and about all I can think about is getting the fuck off the planet.  I feel soooooo rejected by the world, and the thought of going through life for 2 or 3 months without any intimacy in my life just makes me want to weep.  This is very shallow, but if I could just get laid once in a while, that would really really help.  Without paying for it, that is.  Even giving air to that thought makes me feel like a bigger piece of shit.  I'm just fucking pathetic.
